figures.finding: Greenland's Parliament passed a law founding a national film institute (Kalaallit Nunaanni Filminstitutti), to run from 1 January 2026, in charge of production funding, promotion and a new 25% reimbursement of local expenses for foreign productions, which must apply to film in Greenland; its board includes nominees of Film.gl, the Greenland Arts Foundation, the actors' organisation and the employers' association.
figures.applies: Greenland; from 2026; as KFTV reported on 2024-11-22; whether the institute opened as planned was not confirmed.

sources.said: The Parliament of Greenland has passed a law to found a film institute that will be in charge of funding, film promotion and the fresh 25% rebate scheme. The budget is to be established in 2025 … Four organisations will nominate representatives to the board: Film.gl, the Greenland Arts Foundation, the actors' organisation, and the Greenland Employers' Association. … ready to operate from January 1, 2026. … The new law also includes an obligatory application process for foreign production companies that want to film in Greenland, and will access a 25% reimbursement of local expenses.

Yesterday the Parliament (Inatsisartut) unanimously passed a long-awaited law on founding Greenland’s first film institute … The new law also includes an obligatory application process for foreign production companies that want to film in Greenland, and will access a 25% reimbursement of local expenses.
